Privacy.

Contacting BOW

We use the name, contact details, company, service selection and message you provide to respond to your enquiry. The form submits to a hosted enquiry service when that service is configured. A confirmation appears on this page after the service accepts your enquiry. You can also contact info@bowprojects.com.au directly.

In the local review preview, submissions are saved only to a local test outbox. They are not emailed. The form identifies this mode before you submit.

Service providers

When the hosted form is enabled, the hosting and email service providers process information needed to deliver and protect enquiries. Technical information may be used for security and abuse prevention. For information about how your enquiry is retained, or to request a correction, contact BOW using the address below.

Website storage

This website does not include advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Your enquiry is not saved in browser storage. The hosting provider may process technical information needed to serve the website.

External links

Mapping services and LinkedIn have their own privacy practices.

Questions

Contact info@bowprojects.com.au for questions about information you have shared with BOW.
